name: wp-vite-starter
description: WordPress starter theme with a wp-env + Vite local development harness, image optimization, cache-busted assets, and rsync-based CI deployment.

scripts.build:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=local vite build && npm run press:images
scripts.build:stg: cross-env NODE_ENV=staging vite build && npm run press:images
scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production vite build && npm run press:images
scripts.db:import: gzip -dfk sql/wpenv.sql.gz && npm run wp:env run cli wp db import sql/wpenv.sql && rm -f sql/wpenv.sql
scripts.db:export: npm run wp:env run cli wp db export sql/wpenv.sql; gzip -f sql/wpenv.sql
scripts.wp:restart: npm run wp:env start --update && npm run wp:env run cli 'wp rewrite flush --hard'
scripts.wp:setup: npm run wp:start && npm run wp:env run cli 'wp rewrite flush --hard'
scripts.lint:check: npm run lint:html && npm run lint:style && npm run lint:es
scripts.build:prod: vite build && npm run generate-version && npm run press:images && npm run copy-theme

$comment:dom-serializer: Not imported by our code. vite-plugin-svg-sprite-component require()s dom-serializer without declaring it, so it only resolves when npm happens to hoist it to the top level. Declaring it here makes that explicit rather than depending on node_modules layout — without it, `npm ci` can nest it and the build dies with MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Remove only if that plugin is replaced (it was last published in 2022).
$comment:overrides: Transitive-only pins for advisories whose direct dependency has not yet released a bump. Each is a patched release within the same major the parent already asks for, so no parent API changes are involved. Re-check these on each dependency sweep and drop any the parent has caught up with.
author: John Evans
